m.s: Heat the oven to 220°C. Halve {potato} and toss with a little oil and salt on a large lined tray. Roast for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile cut {zucchini} into chunks and trim {greenbeans}. Crush {garlic}. Thinly slice {lemon*0.5} into rounds and juice the rest.
Add the zucchini, beans and {cherrytom} to the tray with the garlic, {oregano}, a drizzle of oil and a pinch of salt. Toss everything together and roast for 5 minutes.
Pat {salmon} dry, season with salt and pepper, and nestle it in among the veg skin side down. Lay the lemon slices on top.
Roast for 10 to 12 minutes until the salmon just flakes in the thickest part and is still a little pink in the middle.
Squeeze over the lemon juice and scatter with chopped {parsley}. Serve straight from the tray.

l: Salmon and veg together. Eat cold with a squeeze of lemon, or warm it gently. Keeps 2 days in the fridge.
